headline: Top line grows despite a one-time charge; outlook raised
summary_short: Cardinal Health's fiscal Q3 2026 revenue rose 11.0% y/y to $60,940M; GAAP operating earnings (EBIT) fell 33.3% y/y to $493M on a $184M goodwill impairment, while non-GAAP diluted EPS rose 35% to $3.17 and full-year non-GAAP EPS guidance was raised to $10.70-$10.80.
summary_long: Revenue rose 11.0% y/y to $60,940M, led by 11% growth in Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions on brand and specialty pharma sales. GAAP operating earnings (EBIT) fell about 33% y/y to $493M on a $184M pre-tax goodwill impairment in the Navista & ION unit tied to a higher discount rate; non-GAAP operating earnings still rose 18% to $956M. GAAP diluted EPS fell 19.9% y/y to $1.69 while non-GAAP diluted EPS rose 35% to $3.17. GMPD segment profit fell 36% on tariffs. Cardinal Health raised and narrowed FY2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance to $10.70-$10.80 and adjusted free cash flow guidance to $3.3B-$3.7B, repurchased $250M of stock (FY26 total $1.0B), and cut leverage to 3.0x.
